# Aqua Ventures Coorg & Just Meen

> Pure mountain spring-water Tilapia fillets, colossal IQF prawns, traditional Coorg Kaipuli marmalade, authentic wood-fired Kachampuli, fresh hydroponics, and integrated agro-ecology farm tours in Siddapur, Coorg, Karnataka.

## Core Products & Offerings
- [Just Meen Seafood](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Pure spring-water Tilapia boneless fillets (₹600/kg), Jumbo Prawns 16/20 (₹650/500g), Medium IQF Prawns (₹600/500g), Handcrafted Fish Momos (₹300/10pcs), Marinated Fish Tikka (₹300/350g), Crispy Fish Croquettes (₹300/10pcs), Fish Fingers (₹300/10pcs), Kaimeen Fish Pickle (₹250/200g).
- [Just Homemade Preserves & Pantry](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Kaipuli (Wild Seville Orange) Marmalade (₹250/350g), Authentic Wood-Fired Coorg Kachampuli Vinegar (₹250/150ml), Kaipuli Bitter Lime Pickle (₹190/250g), Traditional Cut Mango Pickle (₹180/250g), Coorg Black Pepper & Lime Pickle (₹250/250g), Estate Passion Fruit Squash (₹350/750ml), Raw Unpasteurized Forest & Apiary Honey (₹1,250/kg), Artisan Farm Malai Paneer (₹180/200g).
- [Just Fresh Hydroponics](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Soilless Butterhead & Romaine Lettuce (₹80/pack), Tender Spinach / Palak (₹50/250g).
- [Vinessence Superfoods](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#catalog): Sprouted Millet Pastas (Moringa, Beetroot, Spinach, Multi-Millet) (₹180/300g), Sprouted Millet Dosa & Breakfast Mixes (₹160/400g).
- [Agri & Aquaculture Commercial](https://aquaventurescoorg.com/#b2b): High-vigor Tilapia Fingerlings / Seed for commercial aquaculture farmers across Karnataka and South India.

## Cold-Chain Delivery Logistics
- Bangalore: Next-day insulated express delivery on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays. Free delivery on orders above ₹1,500.
- Mysore: Next-day morning doorstep delivery. Free above ₹1,200.
- Mangalore: Next-day coastal run. Free above ₹1,500.
- Coorg: Same-day / next-day estate dispatch. Free above ₹800.
- Pan-India: Express courier delivery across all Indian pin codes for shelf-stable preserves, pickles, honey, and millet superfoods in 2-4 business days.

## Farm Tour & Riverbank Tasting Experience
- Rate: ₹1,500 per Adult | ₹800 per Child (5-12 years).
- Schedule: Daily morning slot (10:00 AM - 1:30 PM with farm lunch) and evening slot (3:00 PM - 6:30 PM with riverside high tea).
- Highlights: Bio-secure concrete raceways, live fish feeding, automated hydroponic nutrient-film greenhouses, honeybee apiaries, and a farm-to-table lunch served on a secluded deck overlooking the Cauvery tributary.
